After multiple failed attempts with HeyGen I finally decided to use my own editing technique to bring you the update about @MightMagicFates .

Alright listen up.
I have been exploring the world of Fates and this game is unreal. I got early access so I was able to play, and trust me it is worth keeping an eye on.

If you want to be early, wishlist Fates on
1. Steam
2. App Store
3. Google Store
4. @Immutable Play

I will drop all links in the comments so you can jump straight in.

Watch the full video because it covers everything you should know about the factions, gameplay, rewards, and the @YGGPlaySummit  Manila energy that is hitting my timeline with full force.

Here is the complete video breakdown so you can follow along easily.

0:00 to 0:06 Intro and faction story
0:06 to 0:10 What Fates is
0:10 to 0:18 Deck building
0:18 to 0:28 Gameplay action
0:28 to 0:34 Rewards and pack opening
0:34 to 0:42 Manila update
0:42 to 0:50 Wishlist Fates
0:50 to 0:56  MMF Discord and X streams
0:56 to 1:00 Outro

PS: from 7 mint to 3 mint, trying my best to make them a bit shorter but what can I say I love to talk...😂

🔥 Venom Foundation Partnerships the Engine Behind Its Global Layer-0 Expansion

Venom Foundation the ADGM-licensed Layer-0 blockchain from the UAE has built one of the most strategic partnership networks in Web3. From governments to exchanges, VCs, enterprises, and incubators, every collaboration pushes Venom closer to its mission: onboard 1 billion users by 2026.

Here’s the ecosystem breakdown (updated to 2025):

🏛️ 1. Government & Public-Sector Alliances

These partnerships focus on CBDC, national digital infrastructure, climate tech, supply chain, and financial inclusion.

🇦🇪 UAE Government (MCCE & IIG)

Building the National Carbon Credit System using Venom’s Layer-0 powering Net-Zero, sustainable agriculture, and biodiversity initiatives.

🇰🇪 Government of Kenya

Launching the Kenya Blockchain Hub in Nairobi (2023) for finance, supply chain, agriculture, and cross-border trade.

🇵🇭 Government of the Philippines

Selected Venom for the National Blockchain Initiative and CBDC exploration (2024).

🇸🇬🇻🇳🇲🇾 Southeast Asian Regulators

Invitations for Venom’s shared Layer-0/Layer-1 infra pilot programs (2025), connecting the region’s open finance development.

🇻🇳 Government of Vietnam (Techsmart Telecom)

Partnership (2025) to build a next-gen financial ecosystem: digital currency platform, blockchain policy advisory & cybersecurity training.

💱 2. Exchange & Liquidity Partners

Supporting listings, liquidity, and global access for VENOM.

KuCoin + KuCoin Ventures Strategic partnership (2024) expanding ecosystem reach to 30M+ users.

https://t.co/kkmMJExVDn Infrastructure & liquidity collaboration.

WazirX / CoinDCX (India) Dual listing (2024) to break into the India market.

Wintermute Liquidity provider + OTC support (2024).
💰 3. Investment & Venture Partners
Fueling Web3 innovation through grants, incubation, and venture backing.
Iceberg Capital Co-launch of the $1B Venom Ventures Fund (2023).

DAO Maker Launchpad, incubation, and Web3 scaling support.

Venom Ventures $5M investment into Everscale (2023) to upgrade core tech.

🛠️ 4. Enterprise & Technology Partners

Real-world integration across payments, logistics, gaming, and security.
United Network Next-gen global payments infra.
MNG Airlines Blockchain-powered air-cargo track & trace (2024).

Alpha MBM Group Digital currency adoption in Africa.

Everscale Core tech collaboration.

Dragonz Land P2E trading-card game onboarding (2024).

Hacken Strengthening Venom’s “Secure by Design” security model.
Developer DAO Expanding TVM usage & innovation.
DoraHacks Global hackathon partner (2023) with $225K prize pool.
🌐 5. Ecosystem & Incubation Partners
Accelerating Web3 startups worldwide.
Hub71 (Abu Dhabi) Major accelerator (2023) integrating Venom into Hub71+ Digital Assets, enabling top-tier venture support and Web3 startup growth.
🚀 Why These Partnerships Matter
Venom isn’t just another chain it’s a regulator-backed, enterprise-ready Layer-0, designed for real-world adoption:

Infinite scalability (dynamic sharding + async architecture)

Compliance-first design (ADGM license)

Zero-emission operations

Secure-by-default infrastructure

Ready for CBDC, DeFi, and Web3 mass onboarding

The global partnership map proves the mission is serious.

🔗 Stay updated: @VenomFoundation
🌍 Website: https://t.co/SeNPmA8NMu
📩 Partnership inquiries: partnerships@venom.foundation

If you want this rewritten again in a short viral tweet style, thread format, or infographic script, just tell me!
